phase_1_foundation.summary: Next.js 14 compiles with 13 routes and FastAPI backend runs; explore page uses mock schemes; search inputs un-wired; citizen scheme details page missing.

phase_2_knowledge_base.summary: 26 genuine, verifiable Maharashtra State and Central schemes populated across 5 mandatory categories with official .gov.in sources; demo records safely archived without breaking foreign keys; live API connected to frontend explore and scheme details view.

phase_3_eligibility_engine.summary: Deterministic boolean evaluator, tri-state classification, and nested rule groups pass all unit tests; frontend /eligibility page fails with 404 due to API route/schema mismatch.

phase_4_conversational_ai_rag.summary: Controlled intents, parameter validation, tool calling, and source grounding implemented; runs with mock keyword provider by default; OpenAI provider requires external key; uses SQL search instead of vector embeddings.

phase_5_vector_voice_tracking_analytics.summary: Vector search is an in-memory Python loop over 0 stored embeddings; voice STT is hardcoded mock in frontend; application tracking lacks user tenancy isolation; analytics returns static hardcoded numbers.

phase_6_production_readiness_scale.summary: Docker Compose fails due to missing Dockerfiles and missing app.worker module; Alembic migration is empty; RBAC is spoofable via X-User-Role header; DELETE /users/me/data wipes all application records.

docker_compose.reason: backend/Dockerfile, frontend/Dockerfile, and backend/app/worker.py do not exist

critical_issues.title: Global Database Wipe on Citizen Data Delete
critical_issues.impact: DELETE /users/me/data deletes all citizen applications across the entire database.

critical_issues.title: Cross-Citizen Data Exposure
critical_issues.impact: GET /applications and GET /users/me/export return all citizens' private application records without user isolation.

critical_issues.title: Spoofable Header-Based RBAC
critical_issues.impact: Any user can escalate privileges to ADMIN by sending X-User-Role: ADMIN header.

critical_issues.title: Eligibility Engine Route and Contract Mismatch
Zero Genuine Government Schemes
critical_issues.impact: Knowledge base contains only 2 fictional test fixtures; users cannot discover genuine schemes.
